issue.title: Make quarkus.rest-client.alpn work in programmatically created client
issue.body:
This is same thing as we do for http2

Fixes: #38499

body:
@geoand thanks for quick fix! I can confirm it's work.

Maybe it would be nice to add note that `quarkus.rest-client.alpn=true` not choose `http/2` when using plain http (I can create that note to docs) or it can be bug in vert.x so it would be better to create issue there?

> Maybe it would be nice to add note that quarkus.rest-client.alpn=true not choose http/2 when using plain http (I can create that note to docs) or it can be bug in vert.x so it would be better to create issue there?

That's for @cescoffier to answer

I set `quarkus.http.http2=true` and `quarkus.rest-client.alpn=true` and by my understanding it should establish h2c with [this example](https://github.com/jedla97/quarkus-reproducers/blob/alpn-client/src/main/java/org/acme/GreetingResource.java#L25) 

When setting HttpClientOptions the example is [here](https://github.com/jedla97/quarkus-reproducers/blob/alpn-client/src/main/java/org/acme/GreetingResource.java#L57) which have alpn enable and http version as list. If I set `etProtocolVersion` to specific version so it's no need for alpn
quarkus.http.http2 is server side. You need `quarkus.rest-client.http2=true`

When setting `quarkus.rest-client.http2=true` I see no point to activate `quarkus.rest-client.alpn=true` or `setUseAlpn(true)` at client will use http2 by default.

So basically alpn should be used only when communicated with https endpoints (tls) in case of quarkus/vert.x. If not I probably missing something. As when using the https endpoint the alpn work without `quarkus.rest-client.http2=true` but on http it use http 1.1

issue.title: Alpn property not work for single rest client reactive
issue.body:
### Describe the bug

This is follow up of #38499 as it was fixed when alpn is enabled in global scope. By https://quarkus.io/guides/rest-client-reactive#http2-support this should be possible for single REST client. But it's not working.
Try to look on it and it seems that it skipping both condition [here in fix](https://github.com/quarkusio/quarkus/blob/main/extensions/resteasy-reactive/rest-client-reactive/runtime/src/main/java/io/quarkus/rest/client/reactive/runtime/RestClientBuilderImpl.java#L413)

In this case alpn not negotiate correct version.

### Expected behavior

Work same as global alpn with only difference alpn will be used only on single client

### Actual behavior

Global alpn work but for single client alpn is skipped/ignored.

### How to Reproduce?

1. `git clone -b alpn-client2 git@github.com:jedla97/quarkus-reproducers.git`
2. `cd quarkus-reproducers`
3. `mvn clean verify`

or

3. `mvn quarkus:dev`
5. `Go to http://127.0.0.1:8080/test-single`

### Output of `uname -a` or `ver`

_No response_

### Output of `java -version`

_No response_

### Quarkus version or git rev

main

### Build tool (ie. output of `mvnw --version` or `gradlew --version`)

_No response_

### Additional information

Reproducer was updated to show this.
